svg.title: The conditional area is the overlap divided by the full condition
svg.desc: X has normal mean one hundred and variance two hundred twenty-five. The event is X below one hundred fifteen and the condition is X above one hundred. The full right half of the normal curve, orange and teal together, is the conditioning area with probability one half. Its teal part from one hundred to one hundred fifteen is the intersection, with probability Phi of one minus one half. Dividing the intersection by the full condition gives approximately zero point six eight two seven using calculator values. Four-decimal cumulative table entries instead give zero point six eight two six. Both methods use the same event; the difference is intermediate table rounding.
